name: add_groups
description: Create many bones/groups in one call — the fast way to lay out a whole skeleton. Pass `groups`: an array of {name, origin, rotation, parent}. A group's `parent` may reference another group created earlier in the SAME call by name, so you can build a nested, pre-posed bone hierarchy at once.

groups.description: Array of group specs: {name, origin:[x,y,z], rotation:[x,y,z], parent:name|uuid}.
